description_en:
Creates a business metric.
Release version: v5.5.0
description_zh:
创建业务指标。
发布版本号：v5.5.0
name: CreateBizMetric

fields.help_en: The list of full names of associated technical metrics. Enter the full name in the format of "OwnerTableFullName.MetricName", where "OwnerTableFullName" equals "AssetSource.OwnerTableName". A technical metric can be associated with only one business metric and cannot be associated repeatedly
fields.help_zh: 关联技术指标全名列表。请填写技术指标的“所属表全名.指标名称”，其中“所属表全名”等于“资产来源.所属表名”。一个技术指标只能被一个业务指标关联，无法重复关联
fields.name: associated_tech_metric_full_names

fields.help_en: The name of the business owner. Enter the username of the owner account
fields.help_zh: 业务负责人名称，请填写负责人账号的用户名
fields.name: biz_owner_name

fields.help_en: The IDs of the folders to which the metric belongs
fields.help_zh: 归属目录ID
fields.name: catalog_ids

fields.help_en: The code of the custom attribute
fields.help_zh: 自定义属性编码
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The list of attribute values. 1. For custom input and single-select dropdown attributes, only the first value in the list is read. 2. For multi-select dropdown attributes, all values in the list are read. 3. For hyperlink attributes, the first value is used as the display text and the second value is used as the redirect link
fields.help_zh: 属性值列表：1、自定义输入和下拉单选属性仅读取列表第一个属性值；2、下拉多选属性，读取列表全部属性值；3、超链接属性，读取列表第一个属性值作为展示文本，第二个属性值作为跳转链接
fields.name: values

fields.help_en: The custom attributes
fields.help_zh: 自定义属性
fields.name: custom_attribute

fields.help_en: The description
fields.help_zh: 描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The display name
fields.help_zh: 展示名称
fields.name: display_name

fields.help_en: The asset labels
fields.help_zh: 资产标签
fields.name: labels

fields.help_en: The metric definition. To reference other business metrics, enclose the metric name in square brackets [ ]
fields.help_zh: 指标口径，如需引用其他业务指标，请使用半角中括号[ ]包裹指标名称
fields.name: metric_definition

fields.help_en: This parameter is read only when the metric relationship diagram is enabled. Enter a calculation expression composed of metric names selected from the related business metrics. Supported operators include +, -, *, /, (, ), %, and ∑. Each metric name must be enclosed in square brackets [ ]. If no operator is specified between two metrics, the system automatically inserts a padding placeholder. If no metric relational expression is configured, the metric relationship diagram switch is automatically shutdown
fields.help_zh: 仅当“指标关系图”开启时会读取此信息。仅支持填写从“相关业务指标”中选取的指标名称组成的一个计算表达式，运算符号仅支持+、-、*、/、（）、%、∑，各指标名称需用半角中括号[ ]包裹。如果两个指标之间未填写运算符，系统将自动填充占位符。如果未配置指标关系表达式，则“指标关系图”开关将自动关闭
fields.name: metric_relation_diagram_expression

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the metric relationship diagram. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

This parameter can be set to true only when at least one related business metric exists. Otherwise, the diagram is automatically disabled
fields.help_zh: 指标关系图开关：true开启；false关闭。当且仅当至少有一个“相关业务指标”时可开启，否则会自动关闭
fields.name: metric_relation_diagram_switch_open

fields.help_en: The name of the business metric. The name must be unique within the tenant. The name can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: -_/\·#$^&*()%+=. The name can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 业务指标名称，需要在租户内唯一。仅支持输入英文字母、数字及部分特殊符号(-_/\·#$^&*()%+=)，最多256字符
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The content of the operation instructions. Only text format is supported
fields.help_zh: 操作说明内容，仅支持文本格式
fields.name: operate_instruction_content

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the operation instructions. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
fields.help_zh: 操作说明是否开启：true开启；false关闭
fields.name: operate_instruction_enabled

fields.help_en: The metric name
fields.help_zh: 指标名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The relationship type. Valid values:
POSITIVE: positive correlation.
NEGATIVE: negative correlation.
OTHER: other
fields.help_zh: 关联关系：POSITIVE正相关；NEGATIVE负相关；OTHER其他
fields.name: relation_type

fields.help_en: The list of related business metrics. Enter the names of related business metrics and their relationships
fields.help_zh: 相关业务指标列表，请填写相关业务指标名称及其关联关系
fields.name: related_biz_metrics

fields.help_en:
The visibility scope type. Valid values:
ALL_USERS_CAN_VIEW: visible to all users.
PART_USERS_CAN_VIEW: visible to specified users.
PART_USERS_CAN_NOT_VIEW: not visible to specified users
fields.help_zh: 可见范围类型：ALL_USERS_CAN_VIEW全部用户可见；PART_USERS_CAN_VIEW部分用户可见；PART_USERS_CAN_NOT_VIEW部分用户不可见
fields.name: scope_type

fields.help_en: The names of user groups. This parameter is read only when the visibility scope is set to PART_USERS_CAN_VIEW or PART_USERS_CAN_NOT_VIEW
fields.help_zh: 请填写用户组名称，当且仅当资产“可见范围”为“部分用户可见”或“部分用户不可见”时会读取此信息
fields.name: user_group_names

fields.help_en: The usernames of individual accounts. This parameter takes effect only when the visibility scope is set to PART_USERS_CAN_VIEW or PART_USERS_CAN_NOT_VIEW
fields.help_zh: 请填写个人账号的用户名，当且仅当资产“可见范围”为“部分用户可见”或“部分用户不可见”时有效
fields.name: user_names

fields.help_en: The visibility scope
fields.help_zh: 可见范围
fields.name: view_scope

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the creation was successful. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 是否创建成功：true成功；false失败
Success.title_en: 是否创建成功：true成功；false失败
Success.title_zh: 是否创建成功：true成功；false失败

Message.description_en: The error details from the backend

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
